description: This is a Java source file defining a Spring Boot configuration class for setting up an MQTT protocol adapter within the Eclipse Hono project. It includes bean definitions for the adapter, properties, metrics customization, and connection event producers.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: Spring Boot configuration class for setting up the MQTT protocol adapter with beans for adapter instance, properties, metrics, and connection event producers.

methods.name: vertxBasedMqttProtocolAdapter
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of VertxBasedMqttProtocolAdapter with prototype scope.

methods.name: adapterProperties
methods.description: Defines a bean for the MQTT protocol adapter properties with prefix 'hono.mqtt'.

methods.name: commonTags
methods.description: Provides a MeterRegistryCustomizer that adds common tags for metrics related to the MQTT protocol adapter.

methods.name: serviceFactory
methods.description: Provides a factory bean for creating instances of the MQTT adapter.

methods.name: connectionEventProducerLogging
methods.description: Defines a connection event producer bean that logs events, conditional on a property.

methods.name: connectionEventProducerEvents
methods.description: Defines a connection event producer bean that uses event backend, conditional on a property.
